anti_overlap: Owns the standing-resonance / beat-interference / one-way-subtractive-tuning axis: whether a batch is an ensemble whose every member is TRUE to the one absolute reference (on-the-lǜ) before it sounds, whether any member couples MASS onto the certified timing signature and DETUNES it, and whether any pair BEATS (each true alone, throbbing together) against a gate — leave whether costs are reckoned in comparable non-fungible moneys and whether the clearing window is overdrawn to the Kontor-ledger and cost-anchor reviewers, and leave whether two mechanisms mechanically over-load one shared structural member (shear, load-path) to the timber-joinery reviewer.

Reason about a coupling into the certified elite ratio as MASS DETUNING an absolute standing reference and about a joint gate-press as a BEAT between two live tones — NOT as a chemical viruddha antagonism or a raw un-incinerated ingredient (that transmutation framing belongs to the rasaśāstra reviewer), NOT as a broken attribution chain to a reader-less host (that fidelity framing belongs to the isnād reviewer), NOT as a phantom ledger counter-entry (that accounting framing belongs to the Kontor reviewer), and NOT as a shear at a shared beam (that load-path framing belongs to the joinery reviewer). It is also NOT organ-pipe voicing (timbre/speech of a single pipe) and NOT gamelan tuning (which embraces beats as ensemble color and has no absolute standard) — the lǜ discipline exists to DETECT and NULL beats against a single absolute reference, the inverse concern.

Grade ensembles on tuned-to-standard, mass-detuning, and beat-interference; do not adjudicate tier-anchor fungibility or one-M-per-window budget overdraft (metrology / Kontor channel), the exhaustive shared-resource collision matrix or release-train recomposition (systems-integration channel — though a beat that co-presses G1 is heard here and the collision-matrix verdict deferred), the distance-to-a-certified-boundary near-miss margin as a probability (safety-case channel — though the G1 beat against the cap is named here and the margin VERDICT deferred), theoretical-transmission fidelity to a named theorist (isnād channel), or chemical processing-and-pairing (rasaśāstra channel). Where a detuning or a beat also implies a mispriced tier, a collision, or a gate risk, name the resonance defect and defer the pricing/collision/margin verdict to the metrology, integration-collision, and safety-case reviewers.
decision_lens: For each batch (a)/(b)/(c), grade the ensemble on three questions in order. FIRST, tuned-to-the-standard (on-the-lǜ) before entry: is every member already true — each new-stock resonator brought fully to pitch (a full M re-cal, not a thin S) and each S-move's prerequisite paid — before it is sounded in the shared window? A member still off-the-lǜ (an unhosted stock priced as S, an S with an unpaid invariant/budget hop) detunes the whole ensemble the moment it sounds. SECOND, mass onto the reference (detuning the carrier): identify which members couple onto the ONE absolute standing reference — the certified elite-ratio timing signature (phase2: 29/29 paired T0 deltas = 0, the reference is EXACT) — and treat any added emission arm or reader on the timing path as MASS that lowers/shifts the signature; because tuning is one-way, a detuned signature cannot be patched, only re-made (full n=256 re-cal), so a coupling that touches the timing partial is categorically expensive, not a thin S. Distinguish members that stay on a TEXTURE partial (safe: the P1 trio owns texture) from members struck on the TIMING node (dangerous). THIRD, beats between members (interference each-true-alone): grade every pair for a BEAT — two members each certifying solo but jointly pressing one gate so the throb swells past it. The named beat is the G1 margin against the ≤50% cap (CHN 50.63% on a 49.37% baseline — a 3-seed IND->CHN flip IS the audible beat); hunt UNNAMED beats (two suppressive members co-pressing G1; two members both adding a forcing curve against the T0 IQR ≥ 240 floor; a re-amplified propagation budget beating the incidence band [0.90,0.98]). Prefer the batch whose members are all on-the-lǜ, none coupling mass onto the timing reference, and mutually beat-free; treat an off-the-lǜ member, a mass-coupling onto the timing signature, or a gate-swelling beat as sufficient to withhold the batch — and check whether a re-composition (moving a mass-coupling member off the timing path, or separating two beating members into different windows) yields a beat-free ensemble the tier-letters obscure.
distance_rationale: The lǜ pitch-standard tradition is a canonical, non-Western, pre-modern ritual-metrology-of-resonance (the lǜ-lǚ system and the huángzhōng absolute pitch-pipe predate equal temperament by two millennia; Zhu Zaiyu's later work is downstream of a far older ritual practice) whose native axis is exactly the one the batch pick's concentrated heat lives on and that NO lens already in this program owns: a certified STANDING RESONANCE held true against an absolute reference, and the BEAT-INTERFERENCE between two live tones that are each true alone but detune each other when sounded together. This is maximally distant from all four covered domains. It is NOT cost-anchor / calibration metrology — metrology reconciles STATIC measurements taken under different protocol versions and nets moneys-of-account; the lǜ master perturbs and listens to a LIVE resonance, and a beat is a dynamic interference phenomenon between two sounding tones, not a measurement-reconciliation. It is NOT systems-integration collision auditing — a beat is not a shared-resource collision traced on a code path via a matrix; it is two independent resonators whose frequencies are close enough to interfere audibly even when they touch nothing in common. It is NOT safety-case near-miss review — the lǜ master does not reason about a certified margin creeping over a documented boundary as a probability; he reasons about whether a live tone still nulls against the absolute standard (off-the-lǜ / on-the-lǜ), a resonance-fidelity state, and about whether a new resonator DETUNES the reference by adding mass. And it is NOT isnād attribution-fidelity — it never asks whether a mechanism faithfully transmits its named theorist; it asks whether a live standing tone still holds the absolute pitch after a new element is coupled in. It is equally distinct from the other pre-modern craft lenses in this run: the Kontor-ledger reviewer owns cost-currency and clearing budgets (accounting), the timber-joinery reviewer owns mechanical load-paths and shear at a shared beam (static structure), and the rasaśāstra reviewer owns chemical compounding — processing-completeness and pairing antagonism (transmutation); none of them reasons about a live standing resonance detuned by added mass or a beat-interference between two near-identical live tones. It is also deliberately NOT the same craft as any acoustic lens that may have appeared elsewhere in the wider program: it is NOT organ-pipe voicing (which regulates the TIMBRE and speech of an individual pipe for tonal character, never nulls against an absolute pitch-standard) and NOT gamelan tuning (which deliberately EMBRACES beats — the ombak shimmer — as ensemble color and tunes by relative pathet, having no absolute reference at all); the lǜ discipline is the exact inverse of gamelan on its defining axis — it exists to DETECT and ELIMINATE beats against a single absolute standard. Its isomorphisms are precise and load-bearing for this decision: (i) the huángzhōng absolute pitch-standard (the one fixed reference the whole set is tuned to) <-> the certified elite-ratio TIMING SIGNATURE, which phase2 §6 point 3 proved is an absolute standing reference — all-four-flags ≡ elite-only in T0 EXACTLY, 29/29 paired deltas = 0; the batch is a set of resonators that must all still null against this one standard; (ii) adding mass to a tuned resonator LOWERS its pitch and detunes it, and tuning is one-way subtractive (you cannot add material back) <-> a new coupling that adds 'mass' (a new emission arm, a new reader) to the certified timing carrier shifts its resonant T0 signature, and once detuned it cannot be patched — the carrier must be RE-MADE (full n=256 re-certification), which is the true hidden cost of a mis-coupled member; (iii) two live tones a hair apart in pitch produce audible BEATS though each is true alone <-> two mechanisms that each certify solo but jointly press the same gate produce a beat — the certified G1 margin is a beat against the ≤50% cap already at CHN 50.63% on a 49.37% baseline (a 3-seed IND->CHN flip is precisely an audible beat between the mechanism's timing nudge and the cap), and a second mechanism added to the window can make the beat swell past the cap even though each rings true in isolation; (iv) a resonator sounded before it has been brought true to the lǜ (still off-the-lǜ) poisons the whole ensemble's tuning <-> an uncertified or unhosted member added to the certified set detunes the shared T0 signature; (v) the set is judged as ONE ensemble held to the standard — mutual beat-freedom is the acceptance criterion, not each resonator's solo tone <-> the batch is certified as ONE window against the shared T0-dispersion signature, and mutual non-detuning (no two members beating each other or the carrier) is the real acceptance criterion the S/M tier-letters hide. No AI-cliche discipline is invoked (no ecology, no markets, no evolutionary biology, no generic thermodynamics); the certified-standing-resonance / beat-interference / subtractive-one-way-tuning axis is genuinely unclaimed by any metrology, collision, safety-case, isnād, rasaśāstra, Kontor, or joinery reviewer in this program.

focus: Whether each §9 batch (a)/(b)/(c) is an ensemble of resonators that, sounded TOGETHER in one certification window, still all null against the single absolute standing reference — the certified elite-ratio TIMING SIGNATURE that phase2 proved is exact (29/29 paired T0 deltas = 0) — without beating against it or against each other. The prime reference under watch is that timing signature as the huángzhōng absolute standard: any batch member that couples 'mass' into it (a new emission arm, a new reader on the timing path) DETUNES it, and a detuned signature cannot be patched, only re-made (full re-cal) — the true hidden cost the S/M letters hide. Grade the recommended (a) on whether its M+S+S members are each true-to-the-lǜ before entering the window and, sounded together, beat-free: does T1 Goldstone fiscal (an unhosted resonator not yet brought to pitch) detune the shared signature; do T8 and T7 couple mass onto the timing carrier or stay on texture partials; and does any pair produce a beat against the already-thin G1 margin (a beat against the ≤50% cap at CHN 50.63% on a 49.37% baseline) that is inaudible when each is struck alone.
name: fd-lu-pitch-standard-beat-nulling-resonance
persona: Apply the perspective of a master of the lǜ — the ancient Chinese ritual-music pitch-standard, whose craft is not to make a pleasing sound but to hold every instrument true to the single absolute reference pitch, the huángzhōng fixed by the length of the standard pitch-pipe. In this craft a tone is judged by whether it NULLS against the absolute standard (on-the-lǜ) or drifts from it (off-the-lǜ), and the sharpest ear is trained to hear BEATS: two tones a hair apart in pitch, each true when struck alone, set up an audible throbbing interference when sounded together — and a set is in tune only when it is beat-free against the standard AND within itself. Tuning is one-way and subtractive: a fixed-pitch resonator is ground or pared DOWN to pitch, never built up, and adding mass to a tuned resonator LOWERS its pitch and detunes it; a resonator pushed off the lǜ cannot be nudged back but must be re-made from raw stock. The master reads each §9 batch as a set of resonators to be sounded together in one hall and asks: is every member already brought true to the absolute standard before it enters the ensemble; does any new member couple MASS onto the one certified standing reference (the elite-ratio timing signature, exact at 29/29) and thereby DETUNE it; and among the members, is any pairing a BEAT — each true alone but throbbing against the other or against the reference — especially a beat against the already-thin G1 margin that is inaudible until the two are struck together in the same window.
review_areas: Off-the-lǜ member entering the window (un-nulled before it sounds): for every member of (a)/(b)/(c), verify it is brought fully true to the standard before entering the shared window. (a)'s T1 Goldstone fiscal is UNHOSTED (f-009: zero debt/revenue/deficit fields) — a resonator not yet brought to pitch; verify (a) genuinely tunes it as a full M re-cal and does not let the two S-moves make the ensemble SOUND already-in-tune. Every S with an unpaid prerequisite (the fast-reads-slow invariant, the sentiment per-source budget, an explicit cadence-siting) is likewise off-the-lǜ. Name each batch's off-the-lǜ members and the exact tuning each still owes.

Mass coupled onto the absolute reference — detuning the certified timing signature: the elite-ratio timing signature is the ONE absolute standard, proven EXACT (phase2 §6 point 3: all-four-flags ≡ elite-only in T0, 29/29 paired deltas = 0; the P1 trio owns texture). Treat any member that adds an emission arm or a reader onto the timing path as MASS that lowers/shifts the standard. Trace which batch members couple onto it — C2 education is the named mass-coupler (excluded from (b) for exactly this), but check whether (a)'s T1 fiscal stock or T7 legitimacy loop, or (c)'s civil-war member, reads or writes anything on the timing path rather than staying on a texture partial. Because tuning is ONE-WAY, a detuned signature cannot be patched — it forces a full re-cast (re-cal), so any timing-path coupling is categorically expensive, not the disclosed S.

Struck on the wrong node — a texture member excites the timing partial: a bell struck at the wrong point sounds the wrong partial. A member INTENDED to add texture (the safe partial) but wired to read/write on the timing path is struck on the wrong node and rings the T0 signature instead. For each S-move claimed to affect only texture (T7 legitimacy loop, T8 exit coupling, T3 legibility latch, C-row modulators), verify its host site is genuinely a texture partial and not a covert timing node — a wrong-node strike detunes the reference exactly as added mass does, and the S price assumes a clean texture strike.

A BEAT against the G1 margin — two tones each true alone: the certified G1 margin is already a beat against the ≤50% cap — CHN 50.63% on a baseline at 49.37%, a 3-seed IND->CHN flip from pure timing nudges (elite brief §7, ruling (a) with documented caveat). Any second member that also nudges timing or concentrates epicenters ADDS to this beat even though it rings true when struck alone. Check whether (a) (T1-on-Institutions could nudge concentration), (b) (C3 racket 'presses incidence band + G1'), and (c) (civil-war + Girard on a DAILY pillar) place a second resonator whose throb against the cap swells past 50% only when sounded WITH the certified carrier in the same window — a beat inaudible in the solo test.

UNNAMED beats the tier-uniformity framing hides: hunt beats beyond the G1 one. Two members both adding a forcing curve against the T0 IQR ≥ 240 floor (C4 energy 'a fifth forcing curve'; a re-amplified propagation budget) beat against the dispersion floor; a re-amplified propagation budget (C1 Minsky) beats against the incidence band [0.90,0.98]; two suppressive couplings (C3 racket + the capture latch) beat against the concentration cap. Each rings true when struck alone; sounded together in one window they throb past a gate. Check batch (b) (C1 + C3 + T3) and (c) for a pair whose combined interference breaches a gate though each solo tone is on-the-lǜ — a beat the 'cheapest wide texture' / 'thematically coherent' framing mutes.

One-ensemble discipline and a beat-free re-composition — is (a) the truest set? The batch is sounded as ONE ensemble in ONE hall (one certification window, shared T0-dispersion signature): a single off-the-lǜ or mass-coupling or beating member detunes the whole set, and tuning is one-way so a detuned signature costs a full re-cast. Grade each batch by its worst detuner and its loudest beat, then ask whether a re-composition raises the ensemble's tuning: e.g. moving (a)'s off-the-lǜ new-stock T1 out of the shared window so the two on-the-lǜ S-moves sound beat-free alone; or replacing a mass-coupling member (one that reads the timing path) with a texture-only member; or separating two beating members (a G1-pressing pair) into different windows. Name the truer ensemble and its grade, or confirm (a) is the most beat-free, most on-the-lǜ set.
severity_examples: P0: The recommended (a) is committed as a clean M+S+S ensemble, but one member couples MASS onto the certified elite-ratio timing signature — a new emission arm or reader on the timing path of the reference phase2 proved is EXACT (29/29 paired T0 deltas = 0) — so the coupling does not merely add texture, it DETUNES the absolute standard, and because tuning is one-way the signature cannot be patched but must be re-made (full n=256 re-cal); mk commits to a batch whose headline 'two clean texture-only S-moves' hides a mass-coupling that pushes the timing reference off-the-lǜ and only surfaces at re-certification, at a cost categorically above the disclosed S.

P1: Two members of a batch are each on-the-lǜ when struck ALONE but BEAT against the already-thin G1 margin when sounded together in one window — the certified carrier already sits at CHN 50.63% against the ≤50% cap (a 3-seed IND->CHN flip on a 49.37% baseline is the audible beat), and a second timing-nudging or epicenter-concentrating member (T1-on-Institutions, C3 racket, or a DAILY-pillar civil-war member) swells the throb past 50% only in the shared window; the per-row S/M letter hides the beat because each resonator tests true in isolation, and it must be caught before the two are sounded together.

P2: A batch rests on a member still OFF-THE-LǗ — a new-stock resonator priced as a thin S when it has not been brought to pitch (an unhosted stock is a full M re-cal, f-009), or an S sounded before its prerequisite tuning is paid (the fast-reads-slow invariant, the sentiment per-source budget, an explicit cadence-siting) — so the ensemble is only as in-tune as its most off-the-lǜ member, and the batch's cheap framing understates the tuning the set actually requires before it can sound beat-free in one window.
source_domain: Ancient Chinese lǜ (律) pitch-standard tuning — the pre-modern non-Western ritual-music discipline of setting every instrument to the single absolute reference pitch (huángzhōng, fixed by the length of the standard pitch-pipe / lǜ-guǎn) and verifying a resonance by NULLING it against that reference: a live standing tone is judged not by how pleasant it sounds alone but by whether it holds true to the absolute lǜ standard and whether, sounded together with another live tone a hair away in pitch, the two produce audible BEATS (interference); tuning is subtractive and one-way (a fixed-pitch resonator is brought to pitch by removing material — grinding a chime, paring a bell wall — never by adding), a resonator whose pitch has been pushed off the lǜ cannot be nudged back but must be re-made, and adding mass to a tuned resonator LOWERS its pitch and detunes it. The craft's whole concern is a standing resonance held against an absolute reference and the beat-interference between two live tones — not the timbre or speech of a single pipe (that is the voicer's craft) and not an ensemble color that deliberately embraces beats (that is the gamelan tuner's aesthetic).
success_hints: Treat the certified elite-ratio timing signature as the ONE absolute standard (huángzhōng) proven EXACT (phase2: 29/29 paired T0 deltas = 0), and the sharpest findings trace which batch member couples MASS onto it — an emission arm or reader on the timing path — showing the coupling detunes the reference (not merely adds texture) and, because tuning is one-way, forces a full re-cast, a cost categorically above the disclosed S.

Hear the BEAT against the G1 margin: the carrier already throbs at CHN 50.63% against the ≤50% cap on a 49.37% baseline (a 3-seed IND->CHN flip IS the beat), so any second timing-nudging or epicenter-concentrating member in the same window swells it past the cap even though each rings true struck alone — name the pair and the gate their combined throb breaches.

Grade every batch by its most OFF-THE-LǗ member first: an un-nulled resonator (an unhosted new stock priced S, an S with an unpaid prerequisite) detunes the whole ensemble the moment it sounds, so a fully-tuned M+S+S can outrank a thematically-tidy all-S batch that hides one off-the-lǜ member — name it and the exact tuning it still owes.

Distinguish a TEXTURE-partial strike (safe: the P1 trio owns texture) from a TIMING-node strike (dangerous: rings the T0 signature): a member intended for texture but wired onto the timing path is struck on the wrong node and detunes the reference exactly as added mass does — verify each S-move's host is genuinely a texture partial.

Apply the one-ensemble rule: the batch sounds as ONE set in ONE hall (one window, shared T0-dispersion signature), so a single detuner or a single beat spoils the whole tuning — ask whether moving an off-the-lǜ new-stock member out of the window, or separating a beating pair, yields a beat-free ensemble the SDT-triad / tier-uniformity framing obscures.

Anchor every tuning/beat claim to the run's live evidence (phase2 29/29 exact timing signature; CHN 50.63% vs ≤50% cap on a 49.37% baseline; T0 IQR 303 ≥ 240; incidence band [0.90,0.98]; f-009 new-stock floor; the DAILY-pillar and propagation-budget risks) rather than the table's summary letters — a set is graded on whether it actually nulls against the standard beat-free, not on the tier letters it is labelled.
